title: Netherstone-Pommelled Bloodthirst
summary: Orin’s NPC-only dagger splits into Bloodthirst and Orin’s Netherstone when looted.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 2 Piercing plus the Finesse modifier. +2 to attack rolls. Simple one-handed melee, 5 ft. Light and Thrown.
fields.Improved Critical: Reduces the number needed to critically hit by 1 for all attack rolls. Stacks with other critical-threshold reductions.
fields.Main hand: Exploit Weakness gives the target Piercing Vulnerability for 1 turn on a melee hit.
fields.Off hand: +1 AC. If an enemy misses you in melee, spend a Reaction to retaliate with the main hand and gain True Strike.
fields.Bound Weapon: Cannot be disarmed and returns when thrown.
fields.True Strike: Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Concentration, up to 2 turns. Your next attack against the target has Advantage.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action, melee weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes hits on the target gain 2 extra Piercing damage. In Honour Mode it takes 2 extra damage of the original type from damage sources. Healing clears the condition. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Availability: Carried by Orin. Looting it gives Bloodthirst and Orin’s Netherstone separately.
fields.Base value: 640 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
